new = '''def nullable(expr):
    """Whether the empty sequence belongs to the expression's language."""
    tag = expr[0]
    if tag == _ALL:
        return True
    if tag == _EMPTY:
        return False
    if tag == _WORD:
        return not expr[1]
    if tag == _PRE or tag == _SUF or tag == _SUB:
        return False
    if tag == _UNION:
        for member in expr[1]:
            if nullable(member):
                return True
        return False
    if tag == _INTER:
        for member in expr[1]:
            if not nullable(member):
                return False
        return True
    return not nullable(expr[1])


'''
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('compiler/compiler.py','w').write(src)
